sonuc.drug_name: Glyxambi 10 mg/5 mg film-coated tablets, Glyxambi 25 mg/5 mg film-coated tablets

what_for.text: Glyxambi is added to metformin, sulphonylurea, or both to treat adult type 2 diabetes.
what_for.evidence: Glyxambi is added to metformin and/or sulphonylurea (SU) to treat type 2 diabetes in adult patients aged 18 years and older

what_for.text: It lowers the amount of sugar in your blood.
what_for.evidence: Thereby Glyxambi lowers the amount of sugar in your blood.

how_to_use.text: Swallow the tablet whole with water.
how_to_use.evidence: Swallow the tablet whole with water.

how_to_use.text: You can take it with or without food at any time.
how_to_use.evidence: You can take Glyxambi with or without food. ... You can take the tablet at any time of the day.

how_to_use.text: The usual starting dose is one 10 mg/5 mg tablet once daily.
how_to_use.evidence: The usual starting dose is one film-coated tablet of Glyxambi 10 mg/5 mg (10 mg empagliflozin and 5 mg linagliptin) once a day.

how_to_use.text: If 12 hours or more remain until next dose, take it when remembered.
how_to_use.evidence: If it is 12 hours or more until your next dose, take Glyxambi as soon as you remember.

how_to_use.text: If less than 12 hours remain, skip it and do not double up.
how_to_use.evidence: If it is less than 12 hours until your next dose, skip the missed dose. ... Do not take a double dose of this medicine to make up for a forgotten dose.

see_doctor_now.text: Stop taking and call a doctor now if you get diabetic ketoacidosis signs.
see_doctor_now.evidence: contact a doctor or the nearest hospital straight away and stop taking this medicine until further advice from your doctor. These symptoms could be a sign of “diabetic ketoacidosis”

see_doctor_now.text: Talk to a doctor immediately if you have genital swelling, redness, and fever.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Talk to your doctor immediately if you develop a combination of symptoms of pain, tenderness, redness, or swelling of the genitals or the area between the genitals and the anus with fever or feeling generally unwell.

see_doctor_now.text: Contact a doctor straight away if you get face, lips, or throat swelling.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Contact your doctor immediately if you notice any of the following side effects: ... allergic reactions, which may be serious, including hives (urticaria) and swelling of the face, lips, tongue, and throat

see_doctor_now.text: Contact your doctor immediately if you get persistent severe stomach pain.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Contact your doctor immediately if you notice any of the following side effects: ... persistent, severe abdominal (stomach) pain

side_effects.text: Low blood sugar is common when taken with insulin or sulphonylureas.
side_effects.evidence: Low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia), seen commonly (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... If you take Glyxambi with another medicine that can cause low blood sugar, such as a sulphonylurea or insulin, you are at risk of getting too low blood sugar

side_effects.text: Uncommonly, it may cause loss of body fluid (dehydration).
side_effects.evidence: Loss of body fluid (dehydration), seen uncommonly

storage.text: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.

storage.text: This medicine does not require any special storage conditions.
storage.evidence: This medicine does not require any special storage conditions.

storage.text: Do not use if packaging is damaged or shows signs of tampering.
storage.evidence: Do not use this medicine if you notice that the packaging is damaged or shows signs of tampering.

unsupported: Urinary tract infections and genital yeast infections are common side effects.

reddedilenler.text: Urinary tract infections and genital yeast infections are common side effects.
reddedilenler.evidence: Urinary tract infection, seen commonly ... genital yeast infection like thrush
reddedilenler.reason: Evidence states urinary tract infection is common, but does not state that genital yeast infection is common.
